chunks: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: The Surah of Al-An'am was revealed all at once, accompanied by seventy thousand angels, until it descended upon Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).
So magnify it and honor it, for the Name of Allah is in it in seventy places. And if people knew what is in it, they would not abandon it.

key_terms.جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً: All at once / as a whole
key_terms.سُورَةُ الْأَنْعَامِ: Surah Al-An'am (The Cattle), the sixth chapter of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of Surah Al-Anam according to Imam Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the unique mode of revelation for Surah Al-An'am, noting it descended all at once accompanied by seventy thousand angels, underscoring its monumental status in Shia tradition. He further emphasizes the frequency of the Divine Name within the chapter as a sign of its spiritual potency, asserting that a deeper comprehension of its contents would compel believers to never neglect its recitation.
